IMP-0390.evidence_requirement: Recall@5 on the planted-mutant paraphrase set for lexical vs semantic, same control set, same seed; plus the exact pinned model id and digest.
IMP-0390.question_or_target: Implement the second-stage semantic matcher over capability descriptions using a version-PINNED local embedding model, with a documented offline fallback when the model is unavailable. Exact question: does the semantic stage recover the paraphrase pairs that the lexical linter provably cannot, measured on the planted-mutant set from IMP-0388?
IMP-0390.retry_policy: max 3 attempts for model-fetch transients; zero retries on a nondeterministic ranking - that is a design defect
IMP-0390.reviewer_requirement: independent-codex-reviewer, fresh context, must re-run the recall measurement
IMP-0390.tests_required: determinism test: same query + same pinned model + same seed yields byte-identical ranking twice. Offline test: with the model absent, the matcher must degrade LOUDLY (typed DEGRADED result), never silently return lexical results labelled as semantic.
IMP-0390.title: Semantic matcher with pinned local embedding model and offline fallback

IMP-0402.evidence_requirement: Timed edit-then-query trace showing the changed answer, plus the observed behavior on a deliberately truncated and a deliberately zero-byte cache file.
IMP-0402.question_or_target: Implement cache invalidation for the capability index using content hash plus mtime, with an explicit corrupted-cache recovery path. Exact target: editing a capability description must change the router's answer on the very next call, and a truncated cache file must trigger a rebuild rather than a crash or a silently empty index.
IMP-0402.retry_policy: max 2 attempts; two-strikes pivot to unconditional rebuild
IMP-0402.reviewer_requirement: independent-claude-reviewer; must specifically check that an empty index is not reported as OK
IMP-0402.tests_required: corrupted-cache test (truncated, zero-byte, wrong-schema); each must rebuild, and an EMPTY rebuilt index must be treated as a failure not a success.
IMP-0402.title: Index staleness invalidation keyed on content hash

IMP-0409.evidence_requirement: Concurrency run output: 50 attempts, exactly 1 grant, 49 typed DENIED results with reason codes. Raw counts, not a summary sentence.
IMP-0409.question_or_target: Implement claim acquire, renew and release for a work unit using atomic tmp-plus-rename with a TTL, so two sessions can never both hold the same unit. Exact question: under 50 concurrent acquire attempts on one unit id, how many claims are granted?
IMP-0409.retry_policy: max 2 attempts; a second double-grant is a design failure - redesign, do not retry
IMP-0409.reviewer_requirement: independent-codex-reviewer, fresh context, re-runs the concurrency test
IMP-0409.tests_required: concurrency test at N=50; crash test where the holder is killed mid-claim and the TTL must eventually release it; a mutation removing the atomic rename must turn the concurrency test red.
IMP-0409.title: Crash-safe work-claim protocol with TTL

IMP-0415.evidence_requirement: A twelve-row condition table mapping each spec condition to the exact function and line that evaluates it; any condition with no implementing line is a gap, disclosed inline.
IMP-0415.question_or_target: Implement the ONE shared completion reducer covering all twelve conditions at spec lines 10631-10644 as a single importable library with no per-caller variants. Exact target: exit code zero alone must be structurally incapable of returning COMPLETE.
IMP-0415.retry_policy: no automatic retry; the reducer is the program's single point of epistemic failure
IMP-0415.reviewer_requirement: 2 independent reviewers: correctness plus an adversarial refuter attempting to construct a false COMPLETE
IMP-0415.tests_required: exit-zero-alone test must return INCOMPLETE. Each of the twelve conditions gets one violating fixture that must be rejected.
IMP-0415.title: Shared completion predicate implemented once as a library

IMP-0421.evidence_requirement: Recorded invocation showing the prompt file path on the command line (not the prompt body), the exit code, AND the non-empty parsed output-last-message file. Exit code alone is SEVERED, not SUCCESS.
IMP-0421.failure_classification: P0-blocking / classes: severed-stream, fire-and-forget, win-arg-limit, codex-exit-n, schema-invalid
IMP-0421.question_or_target: Implement the Codex adapter: blocking foreground invocation, prompt delivered by FILE not inline, --ignore-user-config, and an explicit output-last-message file. Exact target: a work-unit dispatch must be structurally unable to run detached, because a detached result is unreachable by the fan-in barrier.
IMP-0421.retry_policy: max 1 retry ONLY on a win-arg-limit classification, re-invoked with --ignore-user-config; all other failures escalate immediately
IMP-0421.reviewer_requirement: independent-codex-reviewer, fresh context; must confirm the three-signal AND-gate
IMP-0421.tests_required: AND-gate test: exit 0 with a missing or empty output file must classify as severed-stream, not success. Detached-invocation test: any attempt to background must raise at the API boundary.
IMP-0421.title: OpenAI-side work-unit adapter with prompt-by-file transport

IMP-0423.evidence_requirement: A forced-mismatch dispatch showing the DEGRADED verdict, the preserved partial artifact path, and its byte size.
IMP-0423.question_or_target: Implement the degrade-loudly contract at spec line 10983: on a capability mismatch the dispatcher returns a typed DEGRADED result and PRESERVES the partial artifact, never a silent substitution and never a discard. Exact target: there must be no code path where a mismatch produces an ordinary-looking success.
IMP-0423.retry_policy: no automatic retry; retrying a capability mismatch cannot fix it
IMP-0423.reviewer_requirement: adversarial refuter; must attempt to produce a silent success from a mismatch
IMP-0423.tests_required: mismatch test asserting DEGRADED not SUCCESS; artifact-preservation test asserting the partial file still exists after the failure; a mutation that discards the partial must turn the test red.
IMP-0423.title: Degrade-loudly contract for capability mismatch
